_metadata.description: Equipment crafting recipes and processing/refining recipes

design_notes.structure: Flat structure - equipment recipes at top level
design_notes.t4_equipment: Uses T4 processed + dragon_parts + eternal_flame (PvP only)
design_notes.naming_theme: Smyte mythological flavor - gods, titans, divine powers

set_bonus_reference._comment: 6pc bonuses encourage full set commitment with powerful capstone effects

wrath.6pc: +45% ATK, +10% chance to deal double damage

aegis.6pc: +45% DEF, +25% HP, 20% chance to reduce incoming damage by 50%

zephyr.6pc: +75 SPD, 15% chance to take an extra turn

titan.6pc: +45% HP, heal 5% max HP at start of turn

fortitude.6pc: +60% Resistance, immune to debuff duration increases

thunderstrike.6pc: +35% Stun Chance, stunned enemies take +25% damage

relentless.6pc: +30% Extra Turn, extra turns grant +20% ATK

resolve.6pc: +3 turn immunity at battle start, cleanse 1 debuff per turn

conquest.6pc: +60% ATK in PvP, ignore 25% DEF, +15% Crit Rate

eternal.6pc: +60% DEF in PvP, +40% HP, revive once at 30% HP

_processing_notes: Manual crafting versions of what refiners automate. Available in Forge and Alchemist buildings.
